payload.query: What should I wear when it is around freezing outside?

args.text: When it is around freezing (0 °C and below), you should wear three layers: a base layer, a warm mid layer (such as a wool sweater), and an insulated outer layer (such as a puffer jacket) [layering-and-weather#2]. To maintain comfort, it is also recommended to add a hat, like a wool beanie, and a scarf to protect your head and neck [layering-and-weather#2]. For footwear, choose closed, waterproof boots instead of sneakers [layering-and-weather#2].
